value.name: Platinum Option
value.description: death benefit = higher of fund value plus sum assured, or 105% of premiums

variants_or_plan_options.quote: The product provides two Plan Options: Gold Option and Platinum Option. Only one of these options is to be chosen at the inception of the Policy.

entry_age_min.quote: Age1 at Entry Minimum: Maximum: 18 years Limited Pay: 55 years Single Pay: 60 years

entry_age_max.quote: Age1 at Entry Minimum: Maximum: 18 years Limited Pay: 55 years Single Pay: 60 years

policy_term_options.value: limited pay 15-30 years; single pay 5-30 years

premium_min_annual.value: limited pay: Rs 2,50,000 yearly / 1,25,000 half-yearly / 62,500 quarterly / 21,000 monthly

premium_max.value: no limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
premium_max.quote: No Limit, subject to board approved underwriting policy

sum_assured_rule.value: limited pay: 7 x annualised premium; single pay: 1.25 x single premium
sum_assured_rule.quote: Sum Assured Limited Pay: 7 x Annualized Premium

life_cover_multiple_choice.note: fixed by pay type; Platinum adds sum assured on top of fund value

premium_allocation_charge.quote: For Limited Pay Policies: Policy Year PPT 7 Years PPT 10 Years PPT 12 Years 1 to 5 3.00% 3.00% 3.00% 6 years onwards Nil Nil Nil

policy_administration_charge.value: Rs 50 a month (single pay), Rs 100 a month (limited pay); cap Rs 500
policy_administration_charge.quote: For Single Pay policies: Rs.50 per month. 27.1.2. For Limited Pay policies: Rs.100 per month

fund_management_charge.quote: Fund Options FMC (p.a.) Equity Elite Fund II 1.25% Balanced Fund 1.25% Bond Fund 1.00% Money Market Fund 0.25%

mortality_charge.value: per Rs 1,000 sum at risk by attained age, monthly; full table published
mortality_charge.quote: Monthly Mortality Charges = Sum-at-risk × (Annual Mortality Charge per unit Sum-at-risk / 12 )

discontinuance_charge.value: separate tables for limited and single pay (IRDAI caps), nil from year 5
discontinuance_charge.quote: For Limited Pay policies, the Discontinuance Charges will be as per the following table:

switching_charge.value: 2 free a year, then Rs 100 per switch (cap Rs 500)
switching_charge.quote: We will charge You Rs.100 per Switch from 3rd Switch onwards in the same Policy Year.

partial_withdrawal_charge.value: Rs 100 for the second withdrawal in a year (cap Rs 500)
partial_withdrawal_charge.quote: We will charge Rs.100 for the second Partial Withdrawal in any Policy Year.

premium_redirection_charge.value: first free each year, then Rs 100 per redirection (cap Rs 500)
premium_redirection_charge.quote: We will charge Rs.100 per Premium Re-direction from the second Premium Re-direction in the same Policy Year

rider_charges.value: Accident Benefit charge: Rs 0.60 per Rs 1,000 Accident Benefit Sum Assured a year, deducted monthly
rider_charges.quote: where the Annual Rate is Rs 0.60 per 1,000 Accident Benefit Sum Assured.
rider_charges.note: in-built accident benefit, not a separate rider

death_benefit_formula.value: Gold: highest of fund value, sum assured less APW, 105% of premiums. Platinum: higher of fund value plus sum assured, or 105% of premiums
death_benefit_formula.quote: Platinum Option: Higher of 1.1.2.1. Fund Value as on date of the intimation of the death claim to Us plus Sum Assured or 1.1.2.2. 105% of the Total Premiums Paid upto the date of death

maturity_benefit.value: fund value as a lump sum
maturity_benefit.quote: If the Life Assured is alive on the Date of Maturity, We will pay Your Fund Value as the Maturity Benefit in lump-sum as on the Date of Maturity.

fund_switching.value: 2 free a year, then Rs 100; minimum Rs 5,000; allowed during the settlement period too
fund_switching.quote: You can Switch Your Chosen Funds during the Policy Term and also during the Settlement Period, subject to all of the following:

premium_redirection.value: from year 2; first free each year, then Rs 100
premium_redirection.quote: We will allow Premium Re-direction only from the beginning of the second Policy Year.

partial_withdrawals.value: from year 6; 2 a year, 10 in the term; Rs 5,000 minimum, 15% of fund value maximum
partial_withdrawals.quote: We will allow a maximum of 10 Partial Withdrawals in the entire Policy Term.

top_up_premiums.quote: Top up Premiums are not allowed under Your Policy.

settlement_option.value: on death: the claimant may take the death benefit in instalments, staying invested
settlement_option.quote: On death of the Life Assured, the Claimant may choose to get the Death Benefit in instalments during the Settlement Period, provided that the Policy is In-Force or Reduced Paid-Up on the date of death.

policy_loan.quote: Your Policy will not be eligible for any loans.

auto_portfolio_strategies.note: no investment strategies; fund choice only

fund_count.value: 15 funds plus the Discontinued Policy Fund
fund_count.quote: There are fifteen Segregated Funds as listed below available under the Policy, each of which have different riskreturn profiles.

index_or_thematic_funds.value: Pure Fund, Midcap Fund, Flexicap Fund, Large Cap Fund; no index fund

accidental_death.value: in-built: on accidental death, death benefit plus the Accident Benefit Sum Assured; accidental total permanent disability pays it in 10 yearly instalments
accidental_death.quote: an additional benefit equal to the Accident Benefit Sum Assured

value.name: SBI Life - Waiver of Premium Rider - Linked

riders_available.quote: SBI Life – Waiver of Premium Rider – Linked (UIN: 111A049V01)
riders_available.note: the brochure's eligibility table prints the rider UIN as "111AXXXV01" (placeholder)

lock_in_years.quote: You can withdraw post commencement of the 6th Policy Year.

discontinuance_rules.value: IRDAI rules: in lock-in to the Discontinued Policy Fund, after lock-in reduced paid-up
discontinuance_rules.quote: If death occurs during the Lock-In Period and after the Date of Discontinuance in any of the following circumstances, the Death Benefit payable would be equal to Accumulated Value of Your Discontinued Policy Fund

surrender_value_rule.value: surrender allowed any time; value per clause 7
surrender_value_rule.quote: You may Surrender Your Policy any time during the Policy Term.

new_features_not_in_schema.feature: Built-in accident benefit inside a ULIP
new_features_not_in_schema.description: accidental death adds the Accident Benefit Sum Assured; ATPD pays it in 10 instalments; charged at Rs 0.60 per 1,000 a year
new_features_not_in_schema.quote: Accident Benefit Sum Assured in 10 equal yearly instalments where each instalment is equal to 10% of the Accident Benefit Sum Assured.

new_features_not_in_schema.description: nominee can take the death benefit in instalments while staying invested
new_features_not_in_schema.quote: The Death Benefit payable shall continue to be invested in the same proportion of the Chosen Funds as it was maintained at the time of death.
